Supplied by the organisation

Everything the organisation gave us, whatever kind: documents, brand guidelines, films, names we may use, answers to our questions, and the interview (recording and transcript). Tier 1: the first source of truth. When anything here disagrees with folders 01 to 05, this folder wins and the rest fills the gaps.

Name every file with its date and where it came from, for example 2026-09-17_careers-page_apprenticeships.pdf, and log it in Springpod_LEARN_Organisation_Knowledge_Base_V1.docx.
